cs.t: I have a Intel 520 SSD. Fantastic thing I must say and I don't think I can ever use a HDD again, but somehow -- and I realize this may just be baseless -- I don't trust it as much as I trusted my old Seagate HDD, which lasted 7 years. SSDs are getting better now, but are they as reliable as HDD? Can anyone shares his/her expertise on this?
